svg.title: 04 · Workload catalogue
svg.desc: Workload catalogue. Local systems, journeys and services provide shared navigation across provider modules

g.text: Local systems, journeys and services provide shared navigation across provider modules
version · createdAt · updatedAt | Retained versions never change; a write appends the next version.
EntityRef = {kind, id, version}. A dashed class is the same entity shown on another sheet.
All non-Workspace entities carry workspaceId. Cardinalities describe logical associations; fields shown are selected attributes.

g.title: Business system. Provider system aliases are explicit; local metadata changes do not mutate AWS.
A user journey belongs to one system; its service set is derived from Service.memberships.
Business workload boundary, distinct from an AWS service family and a RegisteredService integration.
Scoped service dependency. Provider classification and local governance have separate authority and version ownership.
Canonical inventory identity with explicit stable or run-scoped boundary; does not represent all native objects.

g.text: Service.memberships owns catalogue membership. Provider bindings preserve native identity.
Local catalogue edits and native provider changes use separate command contracts.
